name: Jwt Security Review
summary: Audit JSON Web Token implementations for algorithm confusion, weak secrets, missing validation, and token lifecycle flaws. Use when a codebase or API uses JWTs for auth.

name: Secure Code Review
summary: Perform a security-focused code review — map trust boundaries, audit input paths and auth flows, and use vulnerability-class-driven checklists instead of line-by-line skimming. Use on any PR or codebase with security implications.

name: Stride Threat Modeling
summary: Run a STRIDE-based threat modeling workshop — diagram the system, enumerate threats per element, rank them, and drive mitigations into the backlog. Use during design reviews and new feature planning.
